annotations.title: REST API v1 status for this key

description: The state of the FirmLedger REST API for this account and API key, as /api/v1/me and /api/v1/usage answer it: identity, plan and free-trial status, the key's scopes, live per-minute read/write budgets, durable usage aggregates and the endpoint catalogue. Also states plainly that the MCP connector and REST API v1 are the same platform API — one account, one key, one Pro entitlement — and exactly what happens to API and MCP access when a free trial ends.
